ABOUT DOUBLE9 VENTURES

Advancing bioscience
innovation in Jamaica.

Jamaica has the potential to turn scientific discovery into lasting opportunity.

01 / OUR STORY

Rooted in Jamaica.
Looking to the world.

Its natural resources, agricultural heritage, medical cannabis sector, and research expertise provide a foundation for a bioscience industry with international reach. Double9 Ventures was founded to help build that future.

We are developing an integrated bioscience enterprise that connects pharmaceutical-grade cultivation with applied research, advanced manufacturing, education, and international commercialization. Our goal is to help move promising ideas from research into practical applications, creating long-term value for Jamaica and its people.

A Vision Beyond Cultivation

For us, cultivation is the starting point. The greater opportunity lies in what comes next: research that informs new products, technology that strengthens local capabilities, and education that prepares people to participate in a growing industry.

By connecting these activities, we aim to create a path from scientific discovery to commercial opportunity. That means supporting the transfer of knowledge and technology while building the expertise needed to develop, manufacture, and bring bioscience products to international markets.

Building Through Partnership

An industry grows stronger when people bring different expertise to a shared purpose. Our approach centers on collaboration with researchers, experienced operating partners, government stakeholders, and international commercial organizations.

Through these relationships, we seek to connect Jamaica’s strengths with the scientific expertise, operational experience, and market access needed to compete globally.

Long-Term Value for Jamaica

Our ambition is to help establish Jamaica as a respected center for bioscience innovation—one that serves patients, researchers, healthcare providers, and international markets while creating opportunities at home.

For Double9 Ventures, success means more than bringing products to market. It means developing local talent, strengthening scientific capabilities, and helping build an industry that contributes to Jamaica’s future.
